cohort: All women who gave birth in New South Wales, Australia, between 2002 and 2012
finding: While previous cesarean section was the main contributor to the total cesarean section rate in all groups, nulliparous women with pregestational diabetes had a higher likelihood of cesarean section compared to those without diabetes, highlighting the need to reduce primary cesarean sections in this population.
mod_finding: While previous cesarean section was the main contributor to the total cesarean section rate in all populations, women with pregestational diabetes were more likely to have cesarean deliveries than women without diabetes.
